xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes:

1. The above standalone financial results of Optiemus Infracom Limited (“the Company”) have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 05, 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out a limited review of these results pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, and have issued an unmodified review conclusion.
2. These results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 “Interim Financial Reporting” (Ind AS 34), prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the relevant rules issued thereunder, other accounting principles generally accepted in India and Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.
3. The Company is engaged in the business of trading and distribution, which constitutes a single reportable segment in terms of Ind AS 108 “Operating Segments”. In accordance with Ind AS 108, segment information is presented in the consolidated financial results.
4. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company allotted 14,77,667 equity shares of Rs.10 each at an issue price of Rs.672.25 per share (including premium of Rs.662.25 per share) on conversion of an equal number of warrants issued on a preferential basis, on receipt of the balance 75% of the issue price aggregating Rs.7,450.22 lakh — 5,72,336 shares on July 21, 2026, 7,38,081 shares on August 04, 2026 and 1,67,250 shares on August 11, 2026. Consequently, the paid-up equity share capital increased to Rs.9,016.65 lakh. The holders of the remaining 99,341 warrants did not exercise their option within the period of eighteen months from allotment; the amount of Rs.166.95 lakh received against these warrants has been forfeited in accordance with Regulation 169(3) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 and credited to capital reserve.
5. The figures for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 are the balancing figures between the unaudited figures for the half-year ended September 30, 2026 and the published unaudited figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Previous period figures have been regrouped / reclassified wherever necessary to conform to the current period presentation.
6. The above results are available on the website of the Company (www.optiemus.com) and on the websites of BSE Limited (www.bseindia.com) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (www.nseindia.com).
